name: talk-type
desc: Free, open-source voice typing for Windows — local Whisper dictation into any app via push-to-talk. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT.
features: ✅ **Push-to-talk hotkey** — hold the key, speak, release; text appears in whatever app has focus
✅ **Local Whisper models** — tiny through medium offered with speed and accuracy notes per size
✅ **Punctuation cleanup** — filler words trimmed and sentences capitalized before the text lands
✅ **Language auto-detect** — dictate in two or three languages and it follows the switch
✅ **Snippet commands** — spoken phrases like new paragraph become the real thing
✅ **Dictation history** — last fifty transcripts stored locally for copy or re-insert
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, models download separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Feature | **talk-type** | Windows Voice Typing | Dragon | Whisper scripts |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Free built-in | Paid | Free, OSS |
| Whisper accuracy class | **Yes** | No | No | Yes
| Works fully offline | **Yes** | Yes | Yes | Yes
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Built-in | Installer | Python env
faqQ: best free voice typing on Windows with Whisper accuracy offline?
faqA: Built-in voice typing is convenient but mishears names, and commercial dictation wants a subscription per seat. talk-type runs Whisper locally, cleans punctuation and types straight into the focused app from a push-to-talk key. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline, and transcripts never leave the machine.
